title: Give subagents the right context
brief: A notification feature spans a service and a portal. Provider constraints, UI rules and old advice live in separate documents. Broad prompts repeatedly lose a requirement between research and implementation.
acceptance: Role instructions separate research, implementation and blind verification; rehearse all three locally and report which actually ran.
The handoff preserves current provider and privacy constraints with citations.
The implementation uses the handoff and passes independent tests.
The verifier identifies the planted defect without the author narrative.
